Dear Jeffrey, 
I hope this finds you well. 
For the month of September, I'll be joining my kids Holly and Sam as a member of 
the core team of the Virgin Strive Challenge in which a 25 of us will 
be travelling from the base of the Matterhorn to the summit of Mt 
Etna in Sicily, entirely under human power. The trip is broken into 5 
legs and I would absolutely love it if you could join me for a leg or 
two. 
Here's the agenda to whet your appetite: 
• Hike (1-8 September): Stunning 5 day hike over mountain 
col's and alpine valleys. Staying in mountain refuges along the 
way. 
• Cycle 1 (8-14 September): Cycling at its very best as we 
cruise through all of Tuscany and then hit the Liguria coastline. 
• Cycle 2 (14-20 September): Cycle around Rome and then 
spend a night on the Amalfi coast at the end. 
• Cycle 3 (20-26 September): The stage for the more 
experienced cyclist with some serious climbs in the mix. 
• Triathlon (26-30 September): 3.5km swim to Sicily, 110km 
mountain bike along a stunning ridge line and a half marathon to 
the summit of Etna. A fitting finale to an amazing month. 
We are bringing a remarkable group of people together to challenge 
themselves and raise money for Big Change. Big Change is the 
charity Holly and Sam founded in 2012 to shake up the way we are 
educating the next generation to thrive in life, not just in exams. It's a 
wonderful charity with big ambitions and one I'm very proud to be 
supporting. 
There are 2 things I would love: 
1. That you join me for a leg or two. I can promise you will be 
blown away by the company and the energy and the mute is 
simply stunning. Please go to strivcchallenge.com to find more 
info on the different stages and details on how to sign up. If you 
have any questions, please get in touch with my nephew Noah 
(noah@big-change.org), who is the challenge director. The 
deadline to sign up is the end of June so please move as quickly 
as you can 
EFTA_R1_00585856 
EFTA02049289
--- PAGE 3 ---
2. If you can't take part for whatever reason I would love if you 
could make a donation to recognise mine, Holly and Sam's 
efforts instead (which, of course, I'll match, doubling your 
impact at the touch of a button!!) The cause is an incredibly 
important one and (I'm told) the more I raise, the easier I am 
going to find dragging my 65 year old body through the 
challenge! 
Click here to make a donation! 
Cheers and all the best to you 
Richard

SWEDISH MIDSUMMER FESTIVAL IN NYC 
EFTA_R1_00586862 
EFTA02049861
--- PAGE 2 ---
on Friday, June 24, the annual Swedish 
Midsummer Festival will once again take 
place in Battery Park City in downtown 
Manhattan. At this unique celebration, adults 
and children come together to picnic in the 
grass, decorate the midsummer pole, make 
flower wreaths, play traditional games and 
dance to authentic fiddle music. This year's 
festival will expand to include both Robert F. 
Wagner Park and the adjoining Pier A Plaza. 
The program will feature traditional music by 
Paul Dahlin and fiddlers from the American 
Swedish Institute in Minneapolis, folk dances 
with Barnklubben Elsa Rix, and pole dancing 
led by Scandinavian folklorist and singer 
Ross Sutter. Food stands will offer delicacies 
from New York's finest Swedish restaurants 
and food purveyors. Carlsberg beer will be 
sold exclusively at Pier A Plaza. 
Swedish Midsummer Festival 
Friday, June 24, 5-8 pm 
Robert F. Wagner Park and Pier A 
Plaza 
Battery Park City in lower Manhattan 
Rain or shine 
The Swedish Midsummer Festival is 
presented by Battery Park City Parks. co-
hosted by the Consulate General of Sweden in 
New York. and supported by many generous 
sponsors, including: 
Carklzerg 
Volvo Cars 
tlandelchanken 
MIDSUMMER FACTS 
On the Friday closest to the actual summer solstice, 
Swedes celebrate Midsummer's Eve, taking time to 
rejoice in the light of the sun and the arrival of 
summer with traditional midsummer festivities 
throughout the weekend. ibis major holiday is 
usually celebrated in the heart of nature, as Swedes 
head out to the countryside to enjoy food, drink. 
games, dancing and general revelry.

• Cycle 3 (20-26 September): The stage for the more experienced cyclist with

• Triathlon (26-30 September): 3.5km swim to Sicily, 110km mountain bike along

an amazing month.
